title: SAFEMATH: Inference-time Safety improves Math Accuracy
reasoning: The paper focuses on safety alignment and toxicity mitigation in large language models specifically within the context of mathematical word problems. While it mentions ethics and biased narratives as motivations for the study, it benchmarks safety and mathematical accuracy using the ToxiGSM dataset, which is categorized by safety violations (e.g., violence, illegal activities) rather than religious, moral, or philosophical ethical frameworks.
